items.title: Omar Cooper: Headed for imaging on ankle
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.

items.title: Geno Smith: Set for MRI on ankle
items.text:
Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith will get further imaging on his ankle Monday, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

items.title: Aidan Hutchinson: Initial tests reveal torn ACL
items.text:
Hutchison is expected to miss the remainder of the season after an initial MRI on his injured right knee Monday revealed a torn ACL, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Expected back for Week 11
items.text:
Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Ankle fracture feared
items.text:
The Patriots are concerned that Maye fractured his ankle during Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
